results.title: (PDF) Trends in Artificial Intelligence Research: A Bibliometric Analysis
results.content: Purpose-This study aims to provide a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of trends in Artificial Intelligence (AI) research. With the rapid expansion of AI technologies, it is critical to understand the evolving landscape, key research areas, and influential contributions in the field. This analysis identifies significant trends, emerging topics, and shifts in AI research focus over recent years. Design/Methods/Approach-The study employs bibliometric techniques to analyze data extracted from prominent academic databases such as Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. The data was processed using bibliometric software tools to identify high-impact articles, leading authors, and research hotspots within AI. Findings-The analysis reveals a marked increase in AI-related publications, with a particular rise in deep learning, machine learning, and AI ethics research. Notable shifts include growing attention to interdisciplinary AI applications in healthcare, robotics, and social sciences. Additionally, the analysis highlights a significant increase in international collaboration and the emergence of new leading institutions in AI research. Research Implications/Limitations-The study's reliance on available bibliometric data may limit the inclusion of grey literature or unpublished works. Furthermore, the fast-evolving nature of AI research means that some trends may shift post-analysis. Originality/Value-This study offers a novel, data-driven perspective on the dynamic trends in AI research, contributing to the academic discourse by identifying critical research directions and emerging fields. Future research may explore the societal impact of these trends or perform a comparative analysis across different technological domains.
